worldcombat.skill.appleacid.summary: Hurl a sour apple: on impact it bursts into acid, lowering the Sp. Def of the main target and nearby foes; a target already fermenting takes a harsher second hit (-2). A bubbling sour mash stays where it lands, fermenting foes who step in and biting them repeatedly. Ferment form lingers and stacks more easily; burst form hits harder and splashes wider.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.0: Throw two apples at one target: the first lowers Sp. Def by 1, and a second on a fermenting target lowers it by 2 more
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.1: Splash several foes gathered around the landing point
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.use.2: Seal off a patch of ground with the leftover sour mash
The target struck by the apple takes about %1$s special damage and has its Sp. Def lowered by %2$s stage(s).
The apple flies up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; on impact it bursts, dealing about %4$s special damage to other foes within %3$s blocks of the landing point.
Foes it hits carry a ferment for %2$s; a second apple within that time lowers %1$s stage(s) of Sp. Def instead, refreshing the ferment.
A sour mash of radius %1$s blocks stays for %3$s, dealing about %2$s special damage to every foe inside every %4$s; foes that step in are also fermented.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.ferment.on: Ferment form: impact about %1$s special damage; ferment %2$s, mash %3$s — a slower apple with a smaller splash, but far easier to stack on one target.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.ferment.off: Burst form: impact about %1$s special damage, splash radius %2$s, ferment %3$s — a harder, wider, faster throw, but a shorter ferment.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.growth.0: From level %1$s the impact rises to %2$s power and the splash to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.preference.f: On: a slower apple with a lighter impact and a smaller splash, but ferment ×1.6 and a longer mash — far easier to stack -2 on one target. Off (burst form): a harder, wider and faster single throw, but the acid does not linger.
worldcombat.skill.appleacid.preference.a: Beyond this distance it closes in first. Larger values let it open from further away.
On: it prefers throwing another apple at a target that is already fermenting (the second hit is harsher, -2). Off: it sorts like an ordinary ranged attack.
